copy.curiosityHook: When a rogue plot threatens the entire government, can a lone swordsman's mercenary code keep him alive against forces bent on total upheaval?
copy.description: Wandering mercenary ninja Jubei hires out his lethal talents across Japan. But when a violent conspiracy targeting the government crosses his solitary path, his drifting life—and his survival—fall under immediate threat.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful, and dark. A high-energy animated horror-action hybrid built for focused late-night viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Yoshiaki Kawajiri, this 1993 animated action feature fuses dark fantasy and horror into a relentless, kinetic clash powered by mortal danger and stylized combat.

allowedMaterial: The plot to overthrow the government
Action, dark fantasy, and horror genre tones
